speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough going on for about four weeks now. It's pretty productive, and the phlegm comes out yellowish, but I haven't coughed up any blood. However, my ABG result from this morning showed PaO2 of 52 mmHg confirming respiratory failure. Please use this lab result as the confirmed evidence.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia with Hypoxemic Respiratory Failure. Given the four-week duration of productive cough with yellow phlegm and confirmed hypoxemia (PaO2 52 mmHg), this is consistent with a bacterial pneumonia causing respiratory failure. I will now prescribe appropriate antibiotics and supplemental oxygen. Do you have any known allergies to penicillin or other medications?
